answer_1.quote: We study two generation applications: code summarization and code generation. Code summarization aims to summarize a code snippet into a natural language description.
answer_1.outputs: natural language descriptions of code functions for summarization; code snippets for generation

answer_2.quote: This task is evaluated with BLEU-4. Motivated by these findings we additionally evaluate code generation models with chrF, RougeL and CodeBERTScore metrics.
